headline: Israeli election deadlock triggers coalition talks amid border incursions and security threats
subheadline: Exit polls show Likud at 27 seats with 74.3% turnout, while an Egyptian national was apprehended near Nitzana and a Palestinian operative killed in Gaza.
lede: Israeli elections concluded with a 74.3% turnout, yet exit polls indicate Likud holds 27 seats without a clear majority, prompting coalition negotiations. Opposition leader Benny Gantz urged immediate talks to form a broad Zionist unity government, while Netanyahu faces legitimacy challenges and Eizenkot warned security chiefs to stand firm. Cross‑border incidents included an Egyptian national apprehended near Nitzana and a Palestinian operative killed in Gaza, underscoring persistent peripheral threats. In the Ukraine‑Russia war, Ukrainian forces struck Russian ammunition depots in Donetsk, Luhansk and Zaporizhzhia, while Kyiv air‑raid alerts and drone interceptions highlight ongoing strikes.

sections.title: Ukrainian strikes hit Russian depots, air defenses active
sections.body: Ukrainian defense forces struck Russian ammunition depots and equipment concentrations in Donetsk, Luhansk and Zaporizhzhia regions. Air raid alerts were issued in Kyiv at 19:30 and 22:42 due to drone and rocket threats. Multiple reactive UAVs were detected moving from Bryansk region toward northern Chernihiv, and cross‑border drone activity was reported from Poltava region toward Cherkasy and Chernihiv. Ukrainian air defense intercepted nearly 60% of Russian Geran‑4 drones over the past three months, while rocket and drone threats were tracked across Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Chernihiv and Sumy.

sections.title: Israeli election deadlock fuels coalition talks, border incidents
sections.body: Israeli elections ended with a 74.3% turnout, yet exit polls show Likud holding 27 seats without a clear majority, triggering coalition negotiations. Opposition leader Benny Gantz called for immediate talks to form a broad Zionist unity government crossing political blocs. Cross‑border incidents included an Egyptian national apprehended near Nitzana and a Palestinian operative killed in Gaza after crossing the Yellow Line. Eizenkot declared Netanyahu lacks legitimacy and urged security chiefs to stand firm, while Finance Minister Smotrich warned Arabs would not be allowed to celebrate.

sections.title: Intelligence Assessment
sections.body: The Israeli election deadlock, coupled with cross‑border infiltration attempts and hardline statements, creates a volatile mix of domestic political uncertainty and external security threats that heightens the risk of miscalculation. In Ukraine, Ukrainian strikes on Russian ammunition depots alongside a 60% interception rate of Geran‑4 drones, combined with expanded Russian cross‑border drone operations from Bryansk and Poltava, signals an intensifying logistical war and persistent pressure on civilian areas.
